title: First focused training screen: K1 credit-horizon recipe
doing: Prepare one narrow first-training comparison after accepted S1: matched-game-time K1 gamma/lambda anchor versus direct gamma0.99/lambda0.90, two independent training seeds each, same420 restore/Adam, same pool/rollout/minibatch/LR and equal2359296 actual game frames.
